run_gtest_catch_exceptions_test: run the gtest catch exceptions test suite to verify C++ and SEH exception handling
test_CatchCxxExceptionsTest_fixture_cons: test that C++ exceptions thrown in the test fixture constructor are caught and logged
test_CatchCxxExceptionsTest_SetUpTestCas: test that C++ exceptions thrown in SetUpTestCase are caught and the rest of the workflow completes
test_CatchCxxExceptionsTest_SetUp: test that C++ exceptions thrown in SetUp are caught and TearDown is still called
test_CatchCxxExceptionsTest_unhandled: test that unhandled C++ exceptions abort the program when catch_exceptions is disabled
